layout.title: How a Submarine Dives and Surfaces

shows.does: a sealed steel tube sits in the sea water
the tube bobs up and down on the surface beside a rubber duck
glass tanks under the hull fill with water and the submarine sinks
the submarine keeps sinking until it rests on the bottom
air tanks blow white air into the ballast tanks, the water empties and the submarine rises to the surface by the duck, which rocks away
a glowing outline traces the ballast tanks
the submarine dives, yellow arrows press on the hull and dark cracks appear
a thick steel hull wraps over the cracked one
the steel submarine hangs in the deep water, only drifting up and down
a propeller appears on the stern and spins
the spinning propeller drives it on through the dark deep water, nothing to see by
the submarine rises near the surface and a periscope slides up out of the water
the finished submarine cruises at the surface, propeller spinning, the duck bobbing past it
the finished submarine and the duck

layout.why: A deep pit of sea water in section beside the lawn, with a submarine that floats, floods its ballast tanks to dive, sinks to the bottom, blows the tanks with air to rise, cracks deep down, gets a thick hull, a propeller and a periscope, following the water in and out of its tanks and its trip from the surface to the bottom and back. A rubber duck floats on the surface from the second line and the finished submarine cruises past it at the end. Mid shots on the submarine, close on the tanks and the crack.

sentences.text: If you seal a steel tube in the sea, you have a submarine.
But it floats and bobs like a rubber duck.
So you add tanks that flood, and it sinks.
But it sinks until it sits on the bottom.
So air blows the water out, and it rises.
But the air lets it dive, and pressure cracks the hull.
So you wrap it in thicker steel.
But the steel sub just sits, drifting nowhere.
So you add a propeller that spins and pushes it.
But the spinning propeller drives it blind.
So you rise and raise a periscope.
Now your steel tube cruises the sea by the duck.

story.title: How a Submarine Dives and Surfaces

recurring.what: a rubber duck floating on the surface, bobbing like the first sub and rocked by its rise

chain.shows: the tube bobs on the surface
the flooded sub sinks to the bottom and stays
chain.stakes: the crew is stuck on the seabed

chain.shows: deep down the pressure cracks the hull
the heavy sub just hangs in the water
it drives on in the dark with nothing to see by
chain.stakes: it cannot see ships or the coast

ideas.idea: a sealed steel tube in the sea is a submarine
it just floats and bobs like a rubber duck
ballast tanks flood with sea water so it sinks
now it keeps sinking to the bottom
compressed air blows the water out of the tanks and it rises
now it can dive deep, where the water pressure cracks the hull
a thicker steel hull holds the pressure
it hangs in the water and goes nowhere
it rises near the surface and raises a periscope to see
the finished submarine cruises the sea past the duck
